_shape_note: Corrected 2026-08-09 (tranche 4). The previous stub modelled estimatedMonthlySavings as {"currency", "value"} — the botocore cost-optimization-hub model types it as a plain Double, which is what core/scan_orchestrator.py and services/commitment_scenarios.py read (float(rec.get("estimatedMonthlySavings") or 0)). The dict form could never occur, so a test resting on this fixture verified nothing. Also adds resourceId / resourceArn / actionType / region / source: every bucketing and de-duplication path keys off those, and their absence made the fixture unusable for exercising the type_map. Keys prefixed with _ are stripped by tests/aws_stubs/stub_responses.load_stub_response.
